# Matthew Gann, Ph.D.

> Personal site of Matthew Gann, Ph.D., associate vice chancellor and chief marketing officer at the University of Denver. Purpose-driven marketing and communications executive with more than two decades of experience in higher education, healthcare, and agency leadership. Helps higher education institutions and nonprofits connect strategy, story, and service to the people they serve. Based in Denver, Colorado and Nashville, Tennessee.

Site: https://matthewgann.com
Contact: matthew@matthewgann.com
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/matthewgann/
RSS: https://matthewgann.com/feed.xml

## Pages

- [Home](https://matthewgann.com/): About, at-a-glance credentials, and areas of practice (brand strategy, business and organizational intelligence, marketing operations, reputation and crisis management, leadership and organizational development, digital strategy and analytics).
- [Experience](https://matthewgann.com/experience): Career history (University of Denver; Tennessee Board of Regents; Tennessee Tech University; Wellness Healthcare; WPF Management; N2 The Net; independent consulting), education (Ph.D. and M.O.L., Trevecca Nazarene University; B.S., Tennessee Tech University), credentials (APR; Tennessee Certified Economic Developer), awards, memberships, and community roles.
- [Research and Musings](https://matthewgann.com/research): Writing on marketing, leadership, higher education, and purpose-driven work.
- [Get in Touch](https://matthewgann.com/contact): Email, LinkedIn, and location.

## Writing

- [An Amazing Employee Just Quit. I Couldn't Be Prouder.](https://matthewgann.com/research/2026/10/an-amazing-employee-just-quit): Developing people, supporting their ambitions, and remembering that we work to live.
- [When Marketing Is Invited Too Late](https://matthewgann.com/research/2026/10/when-marketing-is-invited-too-late): Marketing strategy cannot always rescue a poorly conceived organizational strategy.
- [Great Players Want the Truth](https://matthewgann.com/research/2026/07/great-players-want-the-truth): Hard coaching, candor, and what organizations get wrong about protecting top performers.
- [The Real ROO](https://matthewgann.com/research/2026/07/return-on-objectives): ROI versus return on objectives in higher education strategy.
- [One Year In](https://matthewgann.com/research/2026/06/one-year-in): One year as CMO at the University of Denver.
- [The Higher Ed Website Is Dead. We Just Haven't Buried It Yet.](https://matthewgann.com/research/2026/06/future-of-higher-ed-websites): Why higher education websites built like org charts are ending, and what comes next.
- [Responsible for the Sale, Not the Product](https://matthewgann.com/research/2026/06/responsibility-without-authority): Higher ed marketers are held accountable for enrollment outcomes they do not control.
- [Data-Driven Differentiation in Higher Education](https://matthewgann.com/research/2026/05/data-driven-differentiation): Building a repeatable system for figuring out what an institution stands out for.
- [What Purpose-Driven Leadership Actually Looks Like](https://matthewgann.com/research/2026/04/purpose-driven-leadership): Purpose as the filter for every decision, from hiring to campaign strategy.
- [Marketing Maturity in Higher Education](https://matthewgann.com/research/2026/03/marketing-maturity-in-higher-ed): Moving marketing from a production function to a strategic capability.
